intent: Inspect and refactor SensorMetricBoundary without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. Value object SensorMetricBoundary(MetricType metricType, double min, double max, boolean minExclusive) expressing a physical limit (HR 30-240, power 0-2500, cadence 0-220, swim pace >45 s/100m). Values come from configuration, never literals. isWithin is true when value is inside [min,max] (min excluded when minExclusive); validate returns the sample tagged VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED (payload retained, never dropped). Rejects min>max and NaN.
